hints.title: Count Character Frequencies
hints.text: Tally the frequency of each distinct letter in the string.

hints.title: Track Seen Frequencies
hints.text: Iterate through frequencies and maintain a set of occupied frequency values.

hints.title: Greedy Frequency Reduction
hints.text: While the current frequency is already present in the set and greater than zero, decrement it and count a deletion.

hints.title: Full Implementation

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Trying all combinations of deletions across letters causes an exponential search space.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Since alphabet size is 26, greedy decrementing takes at most 26^2 operations in O(k) space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should recognize that reducing duplicates downward to the nearest available integer is optimal.
